product_one_liner.value: AmplifAI unifies contact-center data to deliver automated quality assurance, AI-powered coaching, performance management and next-best actions for frontline agents, team leaders and CX executives.

pricing_page.notes: No public pricing-plan page or pricing navigation link was found; the /pricing URL returned no readable page.

employee_band.notes: The available workforce estimate is 168 employees; this is an estimate, not a company-certified headcount.

founded_year.notes: The company’s contemporaneous 2017 article explicitly says Sean Minter founded AmplifAI in 2016; this takes precedence over conflicting directory metadata.

eng_blog.notes: The public blog index presents contact-center guides, coaching, buyer’s guides and CX analysis, rather than an engineering-authored technical publication.

public_docs.notes: No public product-documentation or help-center link was found; public solution guides and product tours are not a multi-article documentation portal.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The official careers page lists only Senior .Net Full Stack Developer - Plano, not a qualifying AI/ML/data-science title.

model_provider.value: Internally hosted open-source LLMs, including LLaMA
model_provider.notes: The security FAQ names LLaMA and says models operate in isolated environments without sending customer data to public APIs.

compliance_certs.notes: These are the vendor’s public compliance claims/badges, not independent audit verification; HIPAA and GDPR are compliance frameworks, not certifications in the strict sense.

last_funding.notes: Announced September 23, 2025. The $33.7 million includes Series B funding and a credit facility; an equity-only amount was not disclosed.

raised_18mo.notes: The September 2025 announcement falls within May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: No qualifying sales title appears in the official current careers inventory. An undated third-party SDR listing was not sufficient to establish a live opening.

launched_6mo.notes: No qualifying dated product or major-feature launch was found for May 9–November 9, 2026 in the readable publication history. The latest explicit new-capability evidence located is the June 3, 2025 Auto QA post; later solution guides, awards and partnership announcements were not counted as launches.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Luc Dallaire’s profile lists SVP, Digital at AmplifAI beginning July 2026, within the November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: These are publicly listed CRM/service-desk integrations, not proof that AmplifAI uses each system internally for its own sales or marketing.
